name: Tibia Chronicles: Survivors
summary:
Tibia Chronicles: Survivors is a retro-inspired action RPG with survivor-style gameplay. Players control a hero exploring dangerous areas filled with waves of monsters while collecting equipment, leveling up, and unlocking abilities.

The game features multiple character vocations such as Knight, Paladin, Druid, and Sorcerer, each with unique combat styles and abilities. Players must defeat increasingly difficult enemies, manage resources, and build powerful character combinations to survive longer runs.

Inspired by classic MMORPGs and pixel-art RPGs, the game combines idle progression elements with active combat mechanics. Characters can obtain equipment, upgrade skills, and improve their build across multiple play sessions.
